notes.partition: SLURM partition is equivalent to LSF queue
notes.cpus_per_task: Number of CPUs allocated per task (equivalent to LSF -n)
notes.memory_gb: Memory allocation in GB (equivalent to LSF -R rusage[mem=] and -M combined, since SLURM --mem is a hard limit)
notes.constraint: SLURM --constraint is equivalent to LSF -R select[] for OS/feature selection
notes.queue_settings: Optional per-partition overrides. Maps a partition name (from available_partitions) to a dict that overrides the global settings for that partition only. Supported keys: cpus_per_task (or num_cores), memory_gb, os (per-partition defaults); memory_options_gb, enabled_memory_options_gb, cpus_per_task_options, enabled_cpus_per_task_options (per-partition option lists); and enabled_os_options (list of OS names, drawn from the global os_options). Any key that is omitted for a partition falls back to the global value, so configs without queue_settings behave exactly as before.
